## Professional Profile
A 7th-semester Industrial Design student passionate about sustainable, ergonomic, and smart interior design solutions. Skilled in trend forecasting, furniture layouts, lighting planning, and creative problem-solving. Experienced in design workshops and hands-on projects to implement innovative ideas across spatial planning, furniture prototypes, and climate-responsive living.

## Core Design Specializations

- Ergonomic Furniture Design & Joinery Kinematics

## Verified Project Index
All projects have dedicated crawlable case study pages on the website:

1. Worker’s Module (Spatial Design / Modular Shelter)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/workers-module-bagru
   - Location: Bagru, Rajasthan (7-acre site) | Semester: 7th Semester, 2026
   - Brief: Temporary demountable modular shelter system for construction workers and families addressing intense solar heat (NW sun) and monsoon wind paths.
   - Highlights: 9m municipal setbacks, passive ventilation, communal courtyards, zero-waste disassembly.

2. Centre Table (Furniture Design / Multifunctional Table)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/centre-table-furniture-design
   - Location: Furniture Design Studio, Banasthali | Semester: 7th Semester, 2026
   - Brief: Space-saving living room centre table integrating four concealed nesting stools.
   - Highlights: Slatted solid wood top, bent tubular steel cantilever runners, zero footprint expansion.

3. Tide & Terra (Spatial Design / Rooftop Hospitality)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/tide-and-terra-rooftop-cafe-pune
   - Location: Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra | Semester: 6th Semester, 2026
   - Brief: "Blend of Cave and Sky" rooftop hospitality concept with sunken lounge banquettes and panoramic decks.
   - Highlights: Travertine stone piers, teak wood decking, ocean-blue cushions, sunset golden-hour views.

4. Universal Toilet (Spatial Design / Institutional WC)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/universal-toilet-accessible-design
   - Location: Architecture Dept, Banasthali Vidyapith | Semester: 6th Semester, 2026
   - Brief: 364 sq.ft. (28' × 13') accessible barrier-free restroom retrofitting.
   - Highlights: 100% compliant with MoHUA Guidelines, 1500mm turning radii, dual washbasins, 900mm outward doors.

5. Shulabh (Spatial Design / Residential Interior)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/shulabh-residential-interior-ahmedabad
   - Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Semester: 5th Semester, 2025
   - Brief: Sustainable residential concept utilizing traditional Gujarati passive cooling strategies.
   - Highlights: Terracotta jaali lattice screen, polished Kota stone flooring, natural lime-wash, teak wood millwork.

6. Dining Chair (Furniture Design / Ergonomic Seating)
   - URL: https://aanya-interior-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/dining-chair-furniture-design
   - Location: Furniture Design Studio, Banasthali | Semester: 5th Semester, 2025
   - Brief: "Protection & Openness" ergonomic dining chair with sculpted organic frame and woven cord backrest.
   - Highlights: Anthropometrically validated thoracic support (98°–102°), 1:1 scale prototyping, mortise-and-tenon joinery.
